searchText: Customer Experience, Elite Driver Success, Lyft At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive. The ideal candidate is someone who is passionate about customer experience and knows what it means to go above and beyond as an advocate for the Lyft community. You must be calm in the face of a storm, caring and compassionate, and able to have a strong sense of empathy in difficult situations. Our team consists of Customer Experience Associates supporting customers across chat, email and phone.
